# Browser

A headless browser: a Browser service on a Cloudflare Container that runs Playwright (apps/browser).

Id `extras/browser`: Browser rendering, in the Extras slot. Template: [`templates/extras/browser/`](../../templates/extras/browser/).

## What it is for

A headless browser you drive from the server. The `Browser` service sends a URL to a Cloudflare Container that runs Playwright (`apps/browser`) and returns the page title and how many requests it made. Use it as the starting point for screenshots, checks or scraping.

## Add it

When you create the project:

```sh
npm create efforge my-app -- --extras=browser
```

Add it to an existing project:

```sh
npx create-efforge add extras/browser
```

## Needs

- The Cloudflare runtime, which every project has today.

## Conflicts with

Nothing.

## Service and layer

Your code asks for `Browser`, declared in `packages/core/src/browser.ts`, and it fails with `BrowserError`. `BrowserLive` implements it, and `efforge add` puts it in `AppLayer` in `apps/web/src/server/layers.ts`.

- To test code that uses `Browser`, give it a test layer: `Layer.succeed(Browser, Browser.of({ ... }))`. See [Swap a layer to test](../testing.md).
- To change the provider, write another layer for `Browser` and use it in `layers.ts` in place of `BrowserLive`.

## Files it edits

`efforge add` makes these edits with AST transforms, so it changes only what is listed and leaves the rest of each file alone.

### `packages/core/src/index.ts`

- Re-exports everything from `./browser`.

### `apps/web/src/server.ts`

- Exports `BrowserContainer` from `./browser/BrowserContainer`.

### `apps/web/src/server/layers.ts`

- Adds `BrowserLive` to `AppLayer`, imported from `./browser`.

### `wrangler.jsonc`

- Adds a `durable_objects.bindings` entry: `{"name":"BROWSER","class_name":"BrowserContainer"}`. Only with `infra=none`.
- Adds a `migrations` entry: `{"tag":"browser-v1","new_sqlite_classes":["BrowserContainer"]}`. Only with `infra=none`.
- Adds a `containers` entry: `{"class_name":"BrowserContainer","image":"./apps/browser/Dockerfile","max_instances":2}`. Only with `infra=none`.
- Sets `dev.enable_containers` to `false`. Only with `infra=none`.

### `infra/alchemy.run.ts`

- Declares `browser` and binds it to the Worker as `BROWSER`. Only with `infra=alchemy`.

### `apps/web/src/server/run-browser.ts`

- Runs `requireSession` before every server function in the file. Only with `auth=better-auth` or `auth=better-auth-orgs`.

### `apps/web/package.json`

- Adds the dependencies listed below.

### `apps/browser/package.json`

- Adds the dependencies listed below.

### `pnpm-workspace.yaml`

- Pins the new dependencies in the `catalog`.

### `efforge.jsonc`

- Records the add-on in the stack and the hashes of the files it wrote.

## Limits

- With `wrangler.jsonc`, `pnpm dev` does not start containers (`dev.enable_containers` is false), so `Browser` calls fail locally. Set it to true to run the image locally; that needs Docker.
